title: ASEAN in Manila: The arrest of activists protesting Pax Silica
summary: Rappler videographer Jonvic Digma produces this vivid audiovisual document of the encounter between protesters and police

blocks.text: Rappler videographer Jonvic Digma produces this vivid audiovisual document of the encounter between protesters and police

The 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits, held in Manila from November 15 to 18, became a showdown between activists protesting the planned local construction of data centers under the US-led Pax Silica initiative, and police tasked with maintaining order as the Marcos Jr. administration hosts world leaders including US President Donald Trump.

Rappler videographer Jonvic Digma, with reporter Patrick Cruz, captures the gathering of the protesters, their move towards the summit venue in Pasay City, and the tense moments when they encountered Manila police who proceeded to arrest several of them, quite violently in some cases, as shown in this documentary. – Rappler.com
